reason: No monthly fee is good and 99 baht is only two plates of kra pao, but I already watch cooking clips every night for free and basil pork I already make without an app. I cook to spend less, so I don't pay for recipes unless I can see first that it saves me money, and nothing in the free part shows me that.
objection: My kitchen is tiny and I only have one pan. 'Most dishes need one pan' means some don't, and three dishes that keep all week, where would I even keep that much food?
would_change_my_mind: Let me try one Sunday cook-ahead plan for free. If the shopping list really comes out cheaper per meal than a 50-baht plate using only my one pan, I would pay the 99.
